content: To measure expressed (dis)agreement in these speeches, it is necessary to derive a document-level representation of the learned embeddings. Although well-established measurements based on cosine similarity, Euclidean distance, or Pearson correlations could be applied to the word embeddings, we utilized the relaxed variant of a newly introduced document distance measure that exploits information contained in both the word embeddings and term-document matrices: the (relaxed) Word Mover's Distance (RWMD) BIBREF17 .
